---
title: SDK configuration options
description: Init options for the JavaScript, PHP, Dart, and Flutter SDKs.
section: reference
order: 50
---

Init options for the official SDKs. Tracing, analytics, replay, flags, and sample rates also come from project policy via `GET /v1/sdk-config`. Leave `url` unset on Talaria Cloud; the SDK derives `https://ingest-<cell>.newtalaria.com` from the key. Cloud OTLP is `https://ingest-nz1.newtalaria.com/otlp`.

Dart and Flutter options are generated from `TalariaOptions` in the Dart SDK. JavaScript and PHP options come from the shipped configuration pages (those SDK trees were not checked out in the generator workspace).

## JavaScript

Package: `@newtalaria/browser`.

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | yes |  | Publishable tal_pk_ key for browser and React; secret tal_sk_ key for Node. |
| `url` |  |  | Ingest origin. Leave unset on Talaria Cloud; derived from the key as https://ingest-<cell>.newtalaria.com. |
| `release` |  |  | Release name. |
| `minLevel` |  |  | Minimum severity for captured messages. |

Full page: [JavaScript configuration](/sdk/javascript/configuration/).

## PHP

Package: `talaria/talaria`.

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | yes |  | Secret tal_sk_ key (or publishable tal_pk_ where the page says so). |
| `url` |  |  | Ingest origin, or TALARIA_URL. Leave unset on Talaria Cloud. |
| `release` |  |  | Release name. Omit in GitHub Actions or GitLab and the SDK sends <ref>@<shortsha>. |
| `minLevel` |  |  | Minimum severity for captured messages. |

Full page: [PHP configuration](/sdk/php/configuration/).

## Dart

Package: `talaria`.

| Option | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | yes |  | Project API key. Must be present. Official SDKs accept tal_pk_ or tal_sk_ depending on the surface. |
| `url` |  |  | Ingest origin. Leave unset on Talaria Cloud; the SDK derives https://ingest-<cell>.newtalaria.com from the key. |
| `release` |  |  | Release name. Omit in CI and the SDK may send <ref>@<shortsha>. |
| `commitSha` |  |  | Optional commit SHA used when resolving the release identity. |
| `environment` |  |  | Accepted for compatibility; the API key decides the environment. Not stored or sent. |
| `sampleRate` |  | `1.0` | Error sample rate, clamped to 0–1. |
| `maxBatchSize` |  | `50` | Maximum events per flush. |
| `flushIntervalMs` |  | `2000` | Flush interval in milliseconds. |
| `defaultIntegrations` |  | `true` | Install the default integrations. |
| `userId` |  |  | Default user id attached to events. |
| `tags` |  |  | Default tags (string map). |
| `httpTimeoutSeconds` |  | `3.0` | HTTP timeout for ingest requests. |
| `minLevel` |  | `debug` | Minimum log severity the SDK keeps. |
| `enforceDefaultLevel` |  | `false` | When true, the default minLevel cannot be lowered by a logger preset. |
| `loggers` |  |  | Per-logger presets. |
| `beforeSend` |  |  | Callback that may drop or edit an event before send. |
| `ignoreErrors` |  |  | Error patterns the SDK drops. |
| `ignoreUrls` |  |  | URL patterns the SDK ignores. |
| `platform` |  | `dart` | Wire platform field: dart or flutter. |
| `storage` |  |  | Optional identity storage override. |

Full page: [Dart configuration](/sdk/dart/configuration/).
